name: opensession-turn-heuristics
description: Scores the turns of an OpenSession llm-turn-history.jsonl archive: deterministic heuristics for structure/stats/delusion, then an optional grounded LLM judge over the turns a heuristic flagged.

nodes.comment: Parse open-session-jsonl with (ts,id) ordering + id dedupe.
Run the selected deterministic benchmark(s) over parsed turns.
Grounding: web-search factual claims in delusion-flagged turns.
Grounded judge: is a flagged turn a real delusion or a false positive?
nodes.instruction: For each flagged turn you are given the turn text, its discussion thread, and grounding search results. Decide verdict = 'confirmed-delusion' or 'refuted', with a one-sentence reason citing the grounding. Return {"verdicts":[{"turnId":str,"verdict":str,"reason":str}]}.

nodes.comment: Merge heuristic scores + judge verdicts into an opensession-bench-report/v0 object.
